description: This file implements core file system classes and functions, including File, Directory, and Partition, with methods for file info loading, path normalization, directory creation, and permission management.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods for info loading, normalization, and permission checks.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory with methods for creation, existence check, and permission management.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Represents a disk partition with methods for info loading and device name extraction.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes file paths, removing redundant slashes, dots, and handling scope.

methods.name: LoadFileInfo
methods.description: Loads file attributes, size, and timestamps from the filesystem.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path.

methods.name: CreatePath
methods.description: Recursively creates directories along a path.

methods.name: RemoveRepeatedPathSeparator
methods.description: Removes consecutive path separators from a path string.

methods.name: ReadPartitionName
methods.description: Reads the device name associated with a partition (Linux only).

methods.name: LoadPartitionInfo
methods.description: Loads partition size, free space, and device name.
